hdTransferProtocol.owner: independent U32 session/inputSeq; zero skipped; detail-generation reset invalidates suspended publishers
hdTransferProtocol.values: only actual returned person/amount/target values; 255 city/distance and 65535 person mean not yet known
hdTransferProtocol.departure: report8 observes native Thew/cargo debits before the original single AddOrderHead and DelPerson
hdTransferProtocol.commit: monotonic CommitSeq; result1 actual AddOrderHead success, result2 actual rejection/full queue; no rollback added
hdTransferProtocol.retirement: DONE inactive retains last receipt; next begin clears values/result; reset retires the session
hdTransferProtocol.input: read-only; existing menu, quantity, report and map-input receipts remain authoritative

hdDiplomacyProtocol.owner: independent session/inputSeq plus actual detail generation; all skip zero; stale suspended publishers cannot revive a retired owner
hdDiplomacyProtocol.people: actual returned U16 person IDs; actor and target65535 and origin255 are unpublished sentinels; actor selection resets both people each iteration
hdDiplomacyProtocol.commit: phase3 observes original debits before AddOrderHead; exactly one native result is recorded after original DelPerson. Result1 queued, result2 full queue, without rollback or an invented success report
hdDiplomacyProtocol.cancellation: target cancellation returns to a freshly published actor list; actor cancellation follows native command return; no added keys
hdDiplomacyProtocol.retirement: DONE inactive retains an audit receipt; next begin/reset/world commit invalidates previous session and clears people/result
hdDiplomacyProtocol.input: observation only; original PERSON and report native owner receipts remain authoritative; original costs, eligibility and monthly random outcomes are unchanged

hdSpeProtocol.displayedCommit: SysCopyScreen snapshot published by timed_flush_lcd before lcdFlushBuffer

hdDetailProtocol.menuIdentity: current data, generation, context, kind, sequence, count, index, packed names and complete zero-based native ID list; never inferred from names
hdDetailProtocol.successorReceipt: synchronous baye-hd-successor-committed after native loyalty and ownership updates; read-only, before subsequent battle food and monthly processing

hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.identity: U16 zero-based person ID and selected row; full native IDs match before publication, never name matching
hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.publication: temporary selected-row paint ticket; publish only after original set_menu and full menu_ids confirm owner and index
hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.pageRange: actual native spc and exclusive end; propertyCount 0..255 and pageIndex 0..254, no inferred page size

completeness.cumulative: g_hdPersonPropertiesComplete: every property has a captured title and value; prior paint revisions remain explicit
completeness.currentPage: g_hdPersonPropertiesPageComplete: nonempty selected name and all current-page title/value revisions match PaintSeq

text.name: g_hdPersonPropertiesNameGbk
text.encoding: bounded NUL-terminated raw GBK final native strings; nonempty titles, empty values allowed

hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.custom: g_hdPersonPropertiesCustom: observed only in the existing title/value hook branches; no added hook/getter/draw calls
hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.retirement: menu owner, selected row or full IDs change; report/help/qty takeover or native reset invalidates the paint ticket and captured source
hdPersonPropertiesProtocol.input: read-only observer adds no keys or game writes; explicit player LEFT/RIGHT follows original native paging and boundary behavior

hdMakerProtocol.input: original GamDelay(5000, 2), one function key or touch-up returns
hdMakerProtocol.holdSource: last actual SysCopyScreen snapshot of the matching MAKER child; public LCD display must match
hdMakerProtocol.retirement: GamMakerInf return, native reset, or held LCD dirty/copy interference
hdMakerProtocol.custom: same observed showAbout invocation; custom default branch retains LCD

nestedOpaqueCoverage.establishment: same-origin, fully opaque selected rectangles form a containment chain; only actual supported writes and controlled copies establish their current and displayed coverage

hdSpeCompositionProtocol.source: actual ordinary picture draw observed before its matching native attack child
hdSpeCompositionProtocol.background: g_hdSpeBg and g_hdSpeDisplayBg complete resource identity and signed origin
hdSpeCompositionProtocol.displayedCommit: actual SysCopyScreen composition snapshot published by timed_flush_lcd
hdSpeCompositionProtocol.retirement: uncontrolled virtual or LCD writes, nested events, unsupported drawing state, native reset

hdAiTargetProtocol.region: actual before-draw 16x16 target cell within the baseline 160x96 scale-1 LCD; no guessed battle background
hdAiTargetProtocol.baseFormat: 256 row-major original g_VisScr U8 pixel indices; captured once before the first clear or sprite draw

hdAiTargetProtocol.input: read-only observation adds no input, skip, return, attack or skill-result numeric owner; original unskippable keyflag-0 playback remains intact

hdStatusEffectProtocol.baseRgbaFormat: 1024 actual little-endian palette RGBA bytes; identical indices share identical colors and every used palette index remains unchanged
hdStatusEffectProtocol.displayedCommit: actual SysCopyScreen carries fixed subject/base and cumulative clear history; timed LCD flush publishes its matching SPE event/commit/frame ticket
hdStatusEffectProtocol.initialization: phase2 is certified only within the original FgtInit status-check scope, with inactive fight and no guessed command owner
hdStatusEffectProtocol.retirement: uncontrolled drawing, changed subject/map/palette/resource, nested events, overlays, resize, native end or reset permanently invalidates the source
hdStatusEffectProtocol.input: read-only observation adds no skip, return or numeric hold owner; death STATE_SW and zero-HP/zero-Arms upgrades are actual native branch outcomes

hdSkillResultProtocol.scene: owned BACKPIC, verified equal opaque rectangle, or actual-copy-established nested opaque coverage; no unknown full-arena background inferred

mapManifest.note: Full uncropped China LCC plus southern ocean pad. Native city IDs, rules and geographical anchors unchanged. Environment stamps are decorative art, not engine terrain or movement. Keep this work on feature/hd-graphics.

passArt.note: Decorative river-crossing marker only; no terrain, roads, native city coordinates, ownership, passability or input changes. The existing 32 design units scale with the 1920x1080 map canvas.

environment.note: Explicit source raster bounds; river ends at y=3309. Hand-placed stamps illustrate the existing terrain and do not replace the engine grid. Original generated PNGs retained unchanged.
environment.landmarkNote: Manually inspected source-image regions for camera coverage, not precise geographic surveys.

fit.mode: full SVG, no vertical crop; rasterized 3840×3309 then ocean-padded to 3840×4000 so Hainan/Nansha are reachable

geo.note: Map-space HD positions on the full uncropped China LCC raster (Hainan + South China Sea included). Playable map is 3840×4000 after a southern ocean pad. Viewport is a pannable 1920×1080 camera. Engine IDs unchanged.

cities.name: 西凉
cities.jianan: Wuwei / Guzang (凉州武威，游戏称西凉)
cities.note: 词典昵称「西凉」，郡治按武威/姑臧，不是长安以西的抽象一格

cities.name: 北平
cities.note: 右北平，今冀东/京津东北，不是北京城本身

cities.name: 天水
cities.note: 建安朝称汉阳，游戏仍用天水

cities.name: 棉竹
cities.note: 引擎写作「棉竹」，历史作绵竹，成都北

cities.name: 云南
cities.jianan: Yunnan / Yizhou plateau (云南·滇池附近)
cities.note: 引擎格在西南角且孤立；建安图用益州郡/滇池一带，不是交州

cities.name: 建宁
cities.note: 引擎格在东南角，史实在滇东；此即离开 12×8 压缩的最大修正

isolation.scope: Only the server, Chrome child and fresh profile created by this runner are owned

displaySettings.scope: Real period1 LIB/WASM, trusted pointer/keyboard; exact equality of all bridgeWorldExpression fields, no native game inputs during settings checks. No RNG/config/whole-memory claim.
